name: arc-tunnel
description: Local multi-Agent browser automation through one shared Broker

scripts.test: npm --prefix mcp-server test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix extension test
scripts.typecheck: npm exec --prefix mcp-server -- tsc -p mcp-server/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && npm exec --prefix extension -- tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm --prefix mcp-server run build && npm --prefix extension run build
scripts.audit:prod: npm --prefix mcp-server audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && npm --prefix extension audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run check:docs
